title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05123456: Phase 2 NX-14 for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
body: Trial registration for Phase 2 randomized controlled trial of NX-14 (Nexafib) in moderate IPF. Primary endpoint: FVC decline over 24 weeks. Secondary endpoints: quality of life, exercise capacity, adverse events. 180 patients enrolled at 30 sites. Status: Completed. Results available in corresponding PAPER-002. This trial validates the clinical development stage of NX-14.
